The '''Chameleon''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced by [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Rendili Chameleon was added to [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] with patch 5.2 and is available from the Warbound Crusader Pack.

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
